description.value: You know how to take advantage of your enemies getting distracted by your explosions. A creature that fails or critically fails a saving throw against a grenade you throw additionally becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Off-Guard] against the next attack you make against it before the end of your turn.
